device.description: Ethernet device name (e.g., fxp0); fallback if interface not available

savefile.description: Path to pcap savefile for offline analysis

filter_expr.description: BPF filter expression (default: capture DNS on UDP port 53)

ignore_addrs.description: List of IP addresses to ignore (e.g., internal DNS server IPs); multiple allowed

ip_version.description: Filter by IP version; allowed: 'ipv4', 'ipv6', or empty for both

count_queries.description: Count query messages (default: true); set to false to exclude queries

max_levels.description: Maximum domain name label depth for table categorization (1–9)

domain_filter.description: Limit counting to a specific domain name (e.g., example.com)

buckets.description: Number of buckets for hash tables (0 = default)

skip_sources.description: Skip sources + query name counters to reduce memory usage

progress_messages.description: Print progress to stderr in non-interactive mode
